name: COOKIES 'N' CREME
ingredients_raw: Sugar, edible vegetable oil (sunflower and palm oil), cookies (19%) {refined wheat flour (maida), sugar, edible vegetable oil (palm oil), cocoa solids (2%), emulsifier (322 (i)), milk solids, raising agent (500ii)}, milk solids (18.6%), corn syrup solids, edible vegetable oil (palm and palm kernel oil), emulsifier (322 (i)) and flavor (artificial flavouring substance - vanillin).
